name: duplicate_flow
title: Duplicate a flow
description:
Copy a flow into a new draft in the same workspace.
 Texts, email and WordPress forms move over by themselves: while
both are live the original keeps answering, and switching it off hands them to the copy. A campaign
keeps the flow it was launched with. A webhook trigger gets a new address, a web chat trigger a new
widget and a private inbox a new address, so whatever sends to the old one has to be moved. `notes`
says what could not be carried over.
